captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a passenger blimp, consisting of a large, streamlined main envelope in light gray with a long, rectangular under-slung cabin. The tail features a cruciform arrangement of fins, including movable vertical and horizontal control surfaces. On each side of the envelope, a propeller pod is mounted near the cabin, complete with a dark-colored propeller. The propellers are designed to spin continuously, while the control surfaces on the trailing edges of the tail fins rotate on simple revolute joints.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a passenger blimp. The blimp must include a streamlined main envelope, an under-slung rectangular cabin, a cruciform tail with movable control surfaces, and two lateral propeller pods with rotating propellers. Apply a light gray material to the envelope and cabin, and a dark gray material to the propellers.
captions.factory: The code constructs the blimp by lofting circular cross-sections to form the streamlined main envelope. The under-slung cabin is generated using a box primitive positioned below the envelope. The cruciform tail fins are extruded from sketches and joined to the rear of the envelope, with separate trailing-edge control surfaces attached via revolute joints. The propeller pods are created using cylinders and ellipsoidal shapes on the sides, with the propeller blades modeled as rotated boxes arrayed around a central hub and connected via continuous rotation joints.
